d:
Watch the evergreen Nee Nadedare Sogasu Lyrical Video from the classic Kannada movie Anuraaga Aralithu, featuring Dr. Rajkumar, Madhavi and Geetha.
This beautiful romantic song is sung by Dr. Rajkumar, with music composed by Upendrakumar and lyrics penned by Chi. Udayashankar. The film was directed by M. S. Rajashekar.
Directed by: M. S. Rajashekar
Produced by: M. S. Puttaswamy
Written by: Chi. Udayashankar
Artist Name: Dr. Rajkumar, Madhavi, Geetha
Music Director: Upendrakumar
Cinematography: V. K. Kannan
